title: Dispensary Near I-94 Exit in New Buffalo
metaDescription: Need a dispensary near I-94 in New Buffalo? Easy access off the highway, clear parking, fast in-store shopping. Directions + FAQs. 21+.
h1: Dispensary Near I-94 Exit 1 (New Buffalo) — Quick, Easy Pickup

hero.lead: Minutes from the M-239 exit with easy access from US-12 for Indiana + Chicago traffic headed into Harbor Country.

items.title: Getting here from I-94 Exit 1 (M-239 / New Buffalo)
items.md:
1. Take I-94 Exit 1 toward New Buffalo / M-239.
2. Follow M-239 toward New Buffalo.
3. Connect to US-12 and continue to 19189 US-12 (High Society New Buffalo).

[Get Directions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8oANXpmVzFSHBqru8)

items.title: Getting here from US-12 (New Buffalo travel corridor)
items.md:
1. Stay on US-12 through the New Buffalo corridor.
2. Look for High Society at 19189 US-12 (easy pull-in parking).

[Get Directions](https://maps.app.goo.gl/8oANXpmVzFSHBqru8)

items.title: Parking
items.md: **Parking Notes:** Free on-site parking makes this a true highway stop - quick in/out for I-94 travelers and US-12 commuters.

blocks.heading: Fast Pickup, Friendly Team
blocks.md: Walk in, get checked in, and head to the counter. Most visits take under 10 minutes. Our team can point you to popular categories and answer questions. We accept cash and debit; ATMs are available on site. The store and parking are accessible.

blocks.heading: For I-94 + US-12 travelers
items: Easy stop for Chicago / Indiana traffic heading into Michigan

blocks.heading: Crossing state lines
blocks.md: Heading home? Enjoy responsibly in Michigan and don’t travel across state lines with cannabis. Read our [Illinois](/cannabis-laws-by-state/illinois/) and [Indiana](/cannabis-laws-by-state/indiana/) law guides before you go.

blocks.heading: Reviews
blocks.lead: What customers say about High Society New Buffalo.

items.text: Very cool establishment with friendly and helpful budtenders, and a super cute receptionist that always greets me with a smile! Great deals too! Definitely worth stopping.

items.text: Very welcoming staff, and all around vibe of the place, the layout of the store is very nice and spacious, and an amazing display all around. Very clean aswell! Mae was amazing, very polite and patient! helped me find what I was looking for aswell as being informative! 10/10 atmosphere, experience, and customer service! Will defiantly be coming back!!! Thank you!
